title: Kestrel Care Platinum Coverage and the Closed-End Excess Mileage Charge — Kestrel Commercial Fleet Lease
content:
# Cross-Product Schedule — Kestrel Care Coverage and the Closed-End Excess Mileage Charge

**Rule.** For the excess mileage charge on a closed-end commercial unit of the Kestrel Commercial Fleet Lease whose lease ended by a turn-in or by a recovery after an uncured default, the priced amount is multiplied by the mileage maintenance multiplier: 0.90 where the unit's VIN is covered by an active Kestrel Care Platinum Plus or Kestrel Care Platinum Elite contract, 0.95 where it is covered by an active Kestrel Care Platinum contract but by no active Kestrel Care Platinum Plus or Kestrel Care Platinum Elite contract, and 1 where no active Kestrel Care Platinum, Kestrel Care Platinum Plus or Kestrel Care Platinum Elite contract covers it.

**Records read.** The business's Kestrel Care Vehicle Service Contract records: the VIN each contract covers, its plan and whether its status is active. A contract covers the unit when its VIN is the VIN on the unit's schedule.

## Multiplier schedule

| Active Kestrel Care Vehicle Service Contract on the unit's VIN | Mileage maintenance multiplier |
|---|---|
| Kestrel Care Platinum Plus | 0.90 |
| Kestrel Care Platinum Elite | 0.90 |
| Kestrel Care Platinum (and no active Platinum Plus or Platinum Elite) | 0.95 |
| Kestrel Care Powertrain, Gold or Gold Plus only | 1 |
| None | 1 |

## Cases (hypothetical)

1. A priced amount of 1000.00 on a unit whose VIN carries an active Kestrel Care Platinum Plus contract becomes 900.00.
2. The same priced amount with an active Kestrel Care Platinum contract becomes 950.00.
3. A Kestrel Care Platinum Elite contract on the VIN that has expired, with no other contract: multiplier 1, priced amount unchanged.
